tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides consistent, interpretable feature attributions grounded in game theory, ideal for tabular data with mixed feature types. Sensitivity analysis directly measures feature impact by ablation, offering causal insight into individual feature influence. Together, they enable robust detection of low-impact features, while avoiding over-reliance on heuristic reasoning or model-specific biases.
